first_public_date_evidence: The earliest verified public release among the motivating contemporary wheel records is the GitHub commit ed113a71aad3e55cfea728ab44ffdf65edcdbc13 dated 2026-11-08T20:01:35Z for the maximal-general-position-polynomial record; the later facet-spectrum record first appears in commit 6fac21cfe8e463ffb4696ce082829be93203edb1 dated 2026-11-09T01:09:49Z. Both are within the recent window.
scientific_integrity: Infinite-family proof is a homotopy-cofiber argument invoking an established all-length cycle theorem; exhaustive finite calculations are corroboration, not proof of the infinite cases.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary unweighted geodesic general-position complexes of wheels only; four-periodic cycle summands from Deshpande--Singh are prior literature; possible unindexed equivalent results; no independent mathematical audit.
title: The wheel general-position complex is a projective plane at five rim vertices and a periodic sphere wedge thereafter
